reason: Response is 200 with body {"status":"ok"} as documented.

info.title: P2P Practice API
info.description: A small purchase-to-pay API for practicing API testing. Data lives in memory and resets on restart or with POST /admin/reset. There is no authentication. Every rejected request returns {"detail": "...", "rule": "..."}; 404 responses have no rule.

expected: OpenAPI 3.1 spec at /openapi.json (docs/API.md Basics — same API described by generated OpenAPI).
reason: OpenAPI 3.1 document lists System, Vendors, Catalog, PO, and Invoice paths matching docs/API.md endpoints.

intent: Discover seed vendors; pick active vendor for reference
expected: docs/API.md Seed data — vnd-001 active, vnd-002 inactive; GET /vendors lists all vendors.
reason: Two seed vendors returned; vnd-001 is active as documented.

intent: Discover catalog SKUs for PO line items
expected: docs/API.md Catalog — GET /skus lists five SKUs with catalog prices.
reason: Five SKUs returned; chose LUM-2X4-8 and CEM-30KG for the two-line PO.

expected: docs/API.md Vendors — POST /vendors creates vendor, name required, active defaults true, returns 201.
reason: 201 with server-assigned id and active true.

intent: Create draft PO with two line items
expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders — POST creates draft PO with ordered_value and received_quantity 0.
reason: 201 draft PO, ordered_value 95.1, two lines as specified.

expected: docs/API.md — POST submit moves draft to submitted (workflow_gate / flow step 3).
reason: Status changed from draft to submitted.

expected: docs/API.md — receive on submitted PO; PO closes when every line fully received.
reason: All lines fully received; PO status closed and fully_received true.

expected: docs/API.md Invoices — POST returns 201, status received, matched false, partial_receipt null.
reason: Invoice created with total_amount 95.1 matching received value.

expected: docs/API.md — match sets status matched, partial_receipt false when fully received (rule 5).
reason: 3-way match passed with partial_receipt false and aligned totals.

expected: docs/API.md — approve matched invoice posts balanced GL entry (rules 4, 7, 9).
reason: Invoice approved; gl_entry balanced and vendor_exposure 95.1.

expected: docs/API.md — vendor_exposure_math: exposure equals sum of approved invoice totals (rule 11).
reason: open_ap_liability 95.1 matches approved invoice total and approve response exposure.
